messages:
maria: Heads up — bootcamp tenants will start in ap-northeast-7 next week, we need quota increases and networking prep. Looking for p5/p4/g5 seed pool + ENI/EIP headroom. Can infra lift limits on the org account?
ajay: Which account(s) and exact numbers are we asking for? Also confirm ENI and EIP targets per region.
maria: Account: 987654321000. Region: ap-northeast-7 (apne7). Requesting: p5-family -> 16, p4d -> 4, g5 -> 24. ENI quota -> 400, EIP (Elastic IPs) -> 150, NAT Gateways -> 9 (3 per AZ). Subnet sizing: suggest /22 in each AZ for pods + node ENIs.
sam: Quick note — some apne zones have spotty p5 availability; we should ask AWS to confirm AZ capacity and request quota for all AZs (a/b/c). Also consider asking for placement-group capacity if we want low-latency clusters.
infra-ops-bot: Created draft AWS case with summary "apne7 GPU + ENI + EIP seed quota for bootcamp". Attachments: none. Use `@ajay` to submit. :gear:
ajay: Copying the request below before I submit to AWS Support — please check wording.
```
Subject: Request to increase EC2 accelerator and networking quotas for account 987654321000 in ap-northeast-7
Body: Hello AWS Support,
We are onboarding bootcamp/test tenants and require increased accelerator and networking quotas in ap-northeast-7 for account 987654321000. Requested limits: p5-family: 16, p4d: 4, g5-family: 24, ENI limit: 400, EIP limit: 150, NAT Gateway soft limit: 9. Please confirm availability per AZ and recommend if we need placement group/AZ affinity. Expected steady-state: ~120 concurrent GPU nodes, peak burst for training jobs up to 200 nodes for short windows. We can provide architectural diagrams and workload profile on request.
Regards,
Redwood Inference infra team
```
maria: That looks good. Add our expected token throughput and model mix: mostly large-context LLM serving (8k-32k) + occasional training/finetune bursts. Will attach perf numbers if they ask.
dina: Small cost flag — if AWS suggests Dedicated Hosts / Reserved capacity for p5, let's get ballpark estimates before committing. Monthly delta could be big.
ajay: Submitted case -> AWS case # 1234567890. Initial auto-reply: "Please provide usage pattern and whether you require capacity reservations." I pushed our workloads doc and node burst schedule.
aws-support: (system) Case 1234567890 opened. AWS asked for AZ-level distribution and expected sustained vs burst usage. They also asked if customers require single-AZ guarantees.
maria: I'll post AZ distribution and single-AZ tolerance by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
